description: Kubernetes Namespace without an enforced Pod Security Admission level (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce label missing or privileged)

patterns.label: Namespace enforces the privileged Pod Security level

examples:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: shop

kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: jobs
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: privileged
notes: kalkan rule (ADR-0005, K.4; CIS Kubernetes Benchmark 5.2.x). The YAML document (the lines between --- separators) of a top-level kind: Namespace needs a pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce label with a level other than privileged. The kube-system, kube-public and kube-node-lease namespaces are left out. A file with {{ (a Helm or Go template) is skipped: the rendered output decides. A cluster-wide default (AdmissionConfiguration defaults) is not visible to this rule.
